prerequisites: Knowledge equivalent to the 'Database Systems' module is recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: know techniques for conceptual database design and SQL
know basic knowledge of physical database design for central and cloud-based systems and can apply them
can use these systems in an application context
have methodological knowledge for database tuning

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of solutions to at least two exercise assignments

assessment_rules: To acquire credit points, at least 50% of the points from the weekly exercise assignments must be achieved, and the solution of at least two exercise assignments must be orally presented. Grading is done with 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Computer Science degree program. The oral examination is an individual examination.
